content.thinking: Both facts point to the same person: Dame Stella Rimington.

The answer is **Dame Stella Rimington**. She was both the first female DG of MI5 and the first DG whose name was publicly announced upon appointment (in 1992). Previously, MI5 directors general were appointed in secret and their identities were not disclosed to the public.
